Your salivary glands are modified to be capable of spraying a deadly venom. You gain a poison spray unarmed ranged attack with a [range increment](/Rules.aspx?ID=2195) of 10 feet that deals 1d4 poison damage. On a critical hit, the target is also [sickened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=91) 1.
